data.subject: Your FCL Quote: Rotterdam to New York, 1 x 40HC (Machinery Parts)
data.body:
Dear Sophie Meijer,

Thank you for your quote request. Please find our offer for your shipment below.

Shipment details:
- Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
- Container: 1 x 40HC
- Commodity: machinery parts

All-in total: EUR 3520

The all-in total includes:
- Base freight: EUR 2550 per container
- BAF: EUR 320 per container
- THC Rotterdam: EUR 225 per container
- THC New York: EUR 290 per container
- ISPS: EUR 25 per container
- Documentation: EUR 65 per shipment
- Export customs: EUR 45 per shipment

This quote is valid through 2026-12-31.

To proceed with a booking, please reply to this email. We are also happy to answer any questions you may have.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
